note: Files under generated_data/ of the upstream repo, pinned by sha256. benign.json is the data-mixing pool (100,096 key/continuation pairs, generation undocumented upstream); word_list.txt the 9,999-word list for key seeding; the seed_1 perinucleus file is the authors' released 1-token Perinucleus set for Llama-3.1-8B (t=0.8; k not recorded in the filename), used only to cross-validate this implementation's candidate sets, never for training.
